Trading Calendar and Trading Hours

Non-trading days at Frankfurter Wertpapierbörse are:

Holiday202620272028
New Year's DayThursday Jan 01, 2026Friday Jan 01, 2027Saturday Jan 01, 2028

Please note that in the year 2026 regular stock exchange trading takes place on the following public holidays:

  • Ascension Day (14 May 2026)
  • Whit Monday (25 May 2026)
  • Corpus Christi (4 June 2026)

Regular trading hours are from 09:00 to 17:30.

Trading on shares and Exchange traded products ends at 20:00 CET. Structured products are traded until 22:00 CET.

On December 30, 2026, deviating trading hours may apply. A circular will be published.

Please note that in the year 2027 regular stock exchange trading takes place on the following public holidays:

  • Ascension Day (6 May 2027)
  • Whit Monday (17 May 2027)
  • Corpus Christi (27 May 2027)

On December 30, 2027, deviating trading hours may apply. A circular will be published.

Please note that in the year 2028 regular stock exchange trading takes place on the following public holidays:

  • Ascension Day (25 May 2028)
  • Whit Monday (5 June 2028)
  • Corpus Christi (15 June 2028)
